caption: The drawing depicts a horse-drawn sleigh with a matching decorative side panel. The sleigh is primarily yellow in color, with detailed painted borders that feature repeating green, red, and orange leaf patterns. The structure of the sleigh includes wooden panels mounted on a pair of reddish-brown runners and support framework, with visible curved metal braces. The front of the sleigh has an upward-sloping dash board, which frames a black-cushioned seat and footrest positioned inside the sleigh compartment. Attached to the front of the sleigh are two tall, curved shafts, likely intended to connect to a horse. Above the sleigh, there is a separate yellow fragment with a wide black border that matches the sleigh’s painted style, prominently displaying a red, shell-like shape intertwined with curving green leaves and stems, outlined by an irregular edge. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored, highlighting the sleigh and the decorative panel without distraction.
title: New England Cutter
